description: This file contains an extension to the OnboardingView class, adding a method that initiates a chat onboarding process, including loading behavior, message preparation, and sending instructions to the chat model.

classes.name: OnboardingView
classes.description: The class to which this extension adds functionality, related to user onboarding experience.

methods.name: maybeKickoffOnboardingChat
methods.description: Checks various conditions and, if met, initiates an onboarding chat by preparing and sending a greeting message through the chat model.
